name: cache-keepalive
description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm and refreshes it just before it expires

mode.title: Keep-alive mode
mode.description: prompt: when the cache is about to expire and Claude is idle, send a message asking Claude for a minimal acknowledgement, which re-reads the cache and restarts its lifetime. off: only show the timer.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto reads the TTL env vars and settings, then assumes 1h on a subscription within plan limits and 5m otherwise.

leadSeconds.title: Refresh lead (seconds)
leadSeconds.description: How many seconds before expiry the keep-alive fires.

maxIdleMinutes.title: Give up after idle (minutes)
maxIdleMinutes.description: Stop keeping the cache alive once you have not prompted for this long. 0 keeps it alive forever.
